question: Who were members of the States Reorganisation Commission formed in 1953?

options.text: HN Kunzru, KM Panikkar, Fazl Ali

solution:
The correct answer is __**HN Kunzru, KM Panikkar, Fazl Ali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **States Reorganisation Commission** was formed in **1953** by the Government of India to look into the demand for the reorganization of states along linguistic lines.
 
• The commission consisted of three members: **Justice Fazl Ali** (Chairman), **KM Panikkar**, and **HN Kunzru**.
 
• The primary responsibility of the commission was to recommend the reorganization of Indian states to promote administrative convenience and linguistic unity.
 
• The commission submitted its report on **September 30, 1955**, recommending the reorganization of states based on linguistic criteria.
